answers.q1: uv (uv.lock, Python 3.11 per .python-version). Install with: uv sync --locked --extra all
answers.q4: CI runs pre-commit through prek: `uv run prek run --from-ref origin/master --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure`. Use `uv run prek run --all-files` to check everything. The hooks run ruff check, ruff format, mypy, ty, typos, and basic file checks. To run the lint script directly: `uv run bash scripts/lint.sh`. That runs `mypy fastapi`, `ty check`, `ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts` and `ruff format fastapi tests --check`.
answers.q5: uv.lock is a generated lockfile, so don't edit it by hand (change pyproject.toml and run `uv lock`). The files in docs/en/data/ (people.yml, contributors.yml, sponsors.yml, github_sponsors.yml, topic_repos.yml, translators.yml and similar) are filled in by scripts/ jobs and GitHub workflows. The block between the agentbrief:start and agentbrief:end markers in AGENTS.md is also generated. There is no vendored code directory. I did not check whether the translated docs in docs/<lang>/ are generated.
